name: Cylinder Roll
description: The frame wraps around a drum that rolls up, the first clip turning away over its top in a motion blur and the second one coming around from below and unrolling flat. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: curvature
params.description: How much the frame wraps around the drum

params.name: blur
params.description: Length of the motion blur at full speed

params.name: shading
params.description: How much the drum darkens as it turns away

params.name: chroma
params.description: Amount of RGB split along the roll, growing with speed

params.name: downward
params.description: Roll downward instead, the second clip coming around from above
